title: Skill Throwing
wikitext:
This skill governs the use of throwing weapons. Its mainly used for "tagging" while remaining outside the aggro range of a mob.

'''Note:''' Rogues have an ability to land critical hits with throwing after level 13.

== Classes ==

* Bard (Max 113)
* Ranger (Max 113)
* Rogue (Max 250)
* Monk (Max 200)
* Warrior (Max 200)
* Wizard (Max 75)
* Enchanter (Max 75)
* Magician (Max 75)
* Necromancer (Max 75)
